name: Tri-plane Spatial Encoding with Sigma/Color MLPs
definition: A spatial representation pipeline for dynamic NeRF that encodes canonical 3D points using a multi-scale tri-plane grid, predicts volume density and geometry features via a Sigma Net, and computes color via a Color Net using geometry features and spherical harmonics view directions.
summary: Tri-plane Spatial Encoding with Sigma/Color MLPs is a spatial representation for dynamic neural radiance fields that uses multi-scale tri-plane grids and separate density and color networks to achieve high-fidelity reconstruction with smaller memory footprints than voxel grids.
